properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the leaked sentence was loop_status's own field name and `next` line; the lens rode get_skill/list_skills only, and every skill's last instruction is to call loop_status — so the last reply read before the closing words was the one on that path with no lens, and its to-do list is written for the agent in reflow2's nouns with nothing marking it as such
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL, on Anthony's instruction, 2026-09-14, on fact:reflow2-jargon-reaches-the-user-unfiltered-by-the-lens-a-work-session-said-structural-findings-and-undispositioned-drift-to-a-person.

① OBSERVED, verbatim, relayed from a project at his workplace: "Remaining: 6 structural findings and 1 undispositioned drift (the deleted [file], outstanding since before this session). Both are the check-health workflow rather than this one — and its repair step can delete nodes, so it's worth reading what it proposes rather than applying blind." Expected: "6 things about the design's shape to look at, and 1 file the design still lists that was deleted." NOT affected: the same agent's gap questions, which are rephrased through gap_to_prompt and carry the register rule on that tool. First occurrence anyone can point to of the same class: Alex, 2026-08-18, "there are open gaps with X, Y, Z".

② PRECEDENT, searched on the raw phrase: nothing prior holds "undispositioned drift" reaching a person. The design holds the rule (cap:the-register-rule-reaches-the-words, 2026-08-19, lint-checked on detect-and-ask), the reminder on the wire (cap:the-skill-response-carries-the-lens, landed 2026-08-26 on get_skill and list_skills), the requirement that the answer shapes EVERY reply (req:the-agent-learns-who-it-is-talking-to, clause 2), and req:the-reminder-rides-the-response ("a discipline the agent must hold across a long session rides the tool response it already reads").

③ CANDIDATES, generated from the bones: (a) ALLOCATION — the lens governs prose the skills write and the words were a TOOL REPLY. (b) INTENT — the "every reply" clause is still `proposed`, never accepted by the owner. (c) ASSURANCE — the lint proves the obligation is stated in one skill's text, never what a person reads. (d) INTENT/ABSENCE — that project had no background recorded, so the lens was silent. (e) NOT IN THE SUSPECTED COMPONENT — the Stop nudge is the last text an agent reads and is written in reflow2's nouns. (f) THE OBSERVATION IS WRONG — the words came from a skill after all.

④/⑤ MEASUREMENTS, taken 2026-09-14 on the checkout. M1: "undispositioned" occurs in NO served skill and NO served instruction; "structural finding" occurs nowhere. (f) REFUTED. M2: `undispositioned_drift` is a loop_status reply FIELD (report.rs:435) and the `next` line at report.rs:941 reads "…structural defect(s) outstanding — run detect_defects to read them (the check-health skill is the wider workflow; its repair step can delete nodes, so read what it proposes before applying)". The user's sentence is that line paraphrased, with the field name read out as English. (a) CONFIRMED as the source. M3: lens_line has exactly two call sites, get_skill and list_skills (skills.rs:301, lens_for_response); loop_status's reply carries no lens; the loop_hint on write replies ("loop owes: N structural defect(s), N drift(s) awaiting disposition") carries none. M4: the standing register rule in served AGENTS.md and the lens sentence never mention tool replies; loop_status's served description never mentions the reader; the Stop nudge (tools/loop_nudge.py) carries no register line. M5: the `next` prose dates from 2026-07-21 (before the register rule) and the 08-19 and 08-26 fixes touched AGENTS.md, gap_to_prompt, detect-and-ask, get_skill and list_skills — never loop_status. (b) CONFIRMED by get_node: the requirement is `proposed`. (c) CONFIRMED by reading skill_lint: ASK_CONTRACT checks detect-and-ask's text only. (d) NOT MEASURABLE from here — that design is not visible. (e) CONFIRMED as a second unlensed channel on the same moment, though whether it fired in that session is unknown.

⑥ THE CLASS: text written FOR THE AGENT — a to-do list, a hint, a nudge, a gap title — is relayed TO THE PERSON whenever it is the freshest text in context, and nothing marks which text is which. The lens was allocated to the skill rail, the moment of DOING, and never to the loop rail, the moment of FINISHING — and every served skill's last instruction is "before moving on: loop_status", so the closing words are chosen on the loop rail. Would the fix have stopped the 2026-08-18 report? That relay came from gap output, which got its own leg on 08-19; the class is one (reply text relayed) and loop_status was the remaining unlensed reply on the closing path.

⑦ PINNED FIRST: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_loop_status_reply_says_whose_words_to_use.rs (four tests: the silent case names who could be asked; the recorded case names them; the lens names `next` as the agent's list; the lens never withholds `next`) — observed failing before the fix, "0 passed; 4 failed". tools/test_loop_nudge.py test_the_stop_nudge_says_the_next_words_are_read_by_a_person — observed failing before the fix.

⑧ FIXED AT THE CAUSE: loop_status carries `lens` — the same sentence as the skill rail, prefixed by "`next` is the agent's to-do list, written in reflow2's nouns; what a person reads is what it MEANS for their design, in their words" — computed from the read lock already held, best-effort, never withholding the debt. Every Stop-nudge block reason ends with a register line ("What you say next is read by a person, not by reflow2…"). The standing rule in served AGENTS.md gained a paragraph naming tool replies as addressed to the agent. All nine lens tests pass after the fix.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether that project had a reader's background recorded; whether the Stop nudge fired in that session; whether an agent ACTS on the lens — the standing limit every lens record names, and the trial with a non-software reader is still the missing instrument; and the "every reply" clause of req:the-agent-learns-who-it-is-talking-to is still `proposed` and needs the owner's word before the design can say the rule is INTENT rather than prose.
